version: 2
seeds:
- name: wait_milestones
  description: 'Metric 3: editorially chosen moments between GTA V and GTA 6, one row per milestone, each
    dated to a UTC day and carrying one public source. Our picks, not a ranking.'
  config:
    column_types:
      event_date: date
  columns:
  - name: milestone_id
    description: Slug, e.g. black_hole_image.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: event_date
    description: UTC day the event happened.
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: date_precision
    description: day, or month when only the month is certain.
    data_tests:
    - accepted_values:
        arguments:
          values:
          - day
          - month
  - name: category
    description: Theme of the milestone; rockstar marks the Rockstar nods.
    data_tests:
    - accepted_values:
        arguments:
          values:
          - ai
          - computing
          - culture
          - health
          - humanity
          - physics
          - planet
          - release
          - rockstar
          - space
  - name: tier
    description: anchor (the two releases), hero (on the chart) or long (site table only).
    data_tests:
    - accepted_values:
        arguments:
          values:
          - anchor
          - hero
          - long
  - name: title
    description: What happened, in a sentence.
  - name: chart_label
    description: Short label for the chart.
  - name: why
    description: Why it is on the list.
  - name: source_url
    description: One public source for the date.
